messages:
maya: starting prod change window for rollout v2.14 — eu-west region, 30m. keeping canary at 5% initially.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout 1768001234 by maya (policy: gradual, auto-pause on 5xx>0.5% or p95+30% drift).
sam: quick FYI — Added a smoke alert for 5xx rates and a KV cache latency check.
eli: i'm on dashboard duty, will watch SLO panels (latency / errors / kv cache).
oncall-bot: baseline metrics (1h): p95 latency=120ms, error_rate=0.30%, kv_cache_miss_p50=8ms.
rachel: pinning model version during rollout: model=redwood-v2.14-2026-03-19 (temp).
maya: preflight completed, canary instances ready. kicking off shift.
deploy-bot: initiating traffic shift -> canary (5%).
eli: watching metrics... p95 ticked to 135ms, small blip.
sam: smoke alert rule: if request_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m then notify. rule expressed as:
```
expr: (sum(rate(requests{env="prod",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests{env="prod"}[5m]))) > 0.005
```
rachel: also added guard: kv_cache_miss_p50 > 15ms for 3m.
oncall-bot: alert (embed-route): 5xx_rate=0.90% (window=5m) — threshold breached.
maya: pausing rollout now.
deploy-bot: rollout paused per policy: 5xx threshold breach detected. rolling back canary traffic to 0%.
sam: initiating canary rollback to v2.13.
deploy-bot: rollback started.
eli: seeing correlated spike with cache evictions — kv_cache_miss_p50 jumped to 42ms at same time.
rachel: filing quick incident note: suspected kv-cache eviction/rehash after model load. will open followup ticket to adjust cache sizing and pre-warm.
maya: good catch. recording rollback reason in release notes: 'auto-pause due to 5xx spike tied to kv-cache latency; rollback to v2.13'.
sam: can we add a short-lived circuit breaker for embed-route to reduce blast radius next time?
eli: yes, suggest route-level throttling and a fallback model variant. i'll add to ops checklist.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. all canary instances drained.
oncall-bot: post-rollback metrics: p95=118ms, error_rate=0.28%, kv_cache_miss_p50=9ms.
maya: scheduling a follow-up change window tomorrow with cache tuning and extra smoke tests. updating release notes & wikis.
rachel: will create PR to pin v2.13 in blue-green config and add a preflight that asserts kv_cache_miss_p50<12ms.
sam: noted — will prototype a short circuit breaker and feature flag for embed-route.
maya: thanks all, great response. :thumbsup:
